effects: The signer sends `amount` of the vault collateral (AA_FalconXUSDC, 0xC26A…f99C) to the vault via safeTransferFrom, spending the allowance it gave the vault.
Active vault shares worth the deposited amount (minted at the current share price) are credited to `onBehalfOf`, not necessarily to the signer. This is a slashable stake position.
No native value is taken (not payable).
formats.shown: Deposit 123.25 AA_FalconXUSDC for the beneficiary address into the named vault.

findings.title: deposit: shares minted to the beneficiary come from vault storage and are not shown
findings.evidence: Vault.sol deposit: `mintedShares = ERC4626Math.previewDeposit(depositedAmount, activeShares_, activeStake_); _activeSharesOf[onBehalfOf].push(...)`. The descriptor shows only `#.amount` and `#.onBehalfOf`.
findings.fix: None needed. The share count depends on storage. The intent could say the deposit becomes slashable stake.

effects: The signer's active shares are burned. The count is previewWithdraw(amount), rounded up, and must not exceed the signer's balance.
`amount` of collateral leaves the signer's active stake and is queued in the next epoch's withdrawals.
Withdrawal shares for that epoch are credited to `claimer`. Only the claimer can claim the collateral after the epoch ends.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Request a 2.5 AA_FalconXUSDC withdrawal for the claim-owner address from the named vault.

findings.title: withdraw: burned share count and later slashing of the queued amount are not shown
findings.evidence: Vault.sol withdraw: `burnedShares = ERC4626Math.previewWithdraw(amount, activeShares(), activeStake())`. Vault.sol onSlash can cut `withdrawals[currentEpoch_ + 1]` before the claim. The screen shows only 'Requested assets' and 'Claim owner'.
findings.fix: None needed. Both values come from storage. The intent could say funds are claimable after the epoch ends and may be slashed until then.

effects: `shares` of the signer's active vault shares are burned.
Collateral equal to previewRedeem(shares), computed from storage, leaves the signer's active stake and is queued in the next epoch's withdrawals.
Withdrawal shares for that epoch are credited to `claimer`, who alone can claim the collateral later.
No tokens move in this call.
formats.shown: Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares for the claim-owner address from the named vault.

findings.title: redeem: share amount shown as a raw 18-decimal integer in the intent and the field
findings.evidence: descriptor redeem: `#.shares` format `raw`, interpolatedIntent 'Queue {shares} raw shares for {claimer}'. Case 2 renders 'Queue 987654321123456789 raw shares'. ERC4626Math `_decimalsOffset()` returns 0, so shares use the collateral's 18 decimals.
findings.fix: Use format `unit` with params {"decimals": 18, "base": "shares"} so the screen reads about 0.9877 shares.

findings.title: redeem: collateral amount queued for the claimer is computed from storage and not shown
findings.evidence: Vault.sol redeem: `withdrawnAssets = ERC4626Math.previewRedeem(shares, activeStake(), activeShares()); mintedShares = _withdraw(claimer, withdrawnAssets, shares);`
findings.fix: None possible in the descriptor. The intent could name the collateral asset.

effects: The signer's withdrawal for `epoch` is marked claimed. This reverts if the epoch is not over, was already claimed, or is zero.
Collateral (AA_FalconXUSDC) worth the signer's withdrawal shares for that epoch, computed from storage, is sent from the vault to `recipient`, who may differ from the signer.
formats.shown: Claim epoch 42 to the recipient address from the named vault.

findings.title: claim: the asset paid out (AA_FalconXUSDC collateral) is named nowhere on the screen
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claim: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawal', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'. Case 3 shows no token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim AA_FalconXUSDC withdrawal' and 'Claim AA_FalconXUSDC from epoch {epoch} to {recipient}'.

findings.title: claim: the amount sent to the recipient comes from storage and is not shown

effects: Each listed epoch's withdrawal of the signer is marked claimed. This reverts if any epoch is not over, was already claimed, or is zero.
The sum of the signer's collateral (AA_FalconXUSDC) withdrawals over all listed epochs, computed from storage, is sent in one transfer from the vault to `recipient`.
formats.shown: Claim epochs 42, 44 and 128 to the recipient address from the named vault, with each epoch listed.

findings.title: claimBatch: the asset paid out (AA_FalconXUSDC collateral) is named nowhere on the screen
findings.evidence: Vault.sol claimBatch: `IERC20(collateral).safeTransfer(recipient, amount);`. Descriptor intent 'Claim withdrawals', interpolatedIntent 'Claim epochs {epochs.[]} to {recipient}'. Case 4 shows no token.
findings.fix: Name the asset in the intent, e.g. 'Claim AA_FalconXUSDC withdrawals'.
